question: To whom alone may a certain teaching be given after it has been tested for a full year following prior accomplishment?
premises: The teaching is only to be given to one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one full year.
The act of giving is restricted by both prior accomplishment and prior testing.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to a previously accomplished person who has been tested for one year.
uncertainties: Criteria for prior accomplishment remain unspecified
plain_english: The teaching is to be given only to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
